notes: Web control: open the panel in any browser on your Tailscale network to see what is playing, play and queue pieces, browse the library, start channels, adjust the piano, and add pieces by dropping MIDI or zip files onto the page. Guests can request a piece by scanning the printable poster, one request every five minutes, with an approve-first switch. Turn it on under Piano › Remote control and set a six-digit PIN. Also: hardening from the security audit of the panel, a larger title on the standby screen, and small fixes.
